rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT method with a minor variation (spin-restricted NEB with spin-polarized TS single-point corrections) using a widely available code (Quantum ESPRESSO). Requires routine understanding of formation energies, NEB, and spin states, but no novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: 2-3 sequential stages: prepare supercell coordinates, run geometry optimizations, then NEB calculations, post-process into JSON. Straightforward scripting and I/O, no complex data acquisition or multi-environment orchestration.

Resources are moderate: a 216-atom supercell at Γ-point can run on a single CPU node with a few GB of memory and no GPU.
